name: week-capsules
title: Week Capsules
description: A week of minutes: capsules fill in turn, glowing at the goal, and today's breathes inside a ring.

perf.budget: Capsules use short UI-thread springs on arrival. Today's ring breathes as one view, so it animates at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: Capsules appear filled, the ring holds still and the number does not count.
